RAG (Read-Answer-Generate) is a novel approach that combines the strengths of extractive question answering (QA) and abstractive question answering (QA). In this context, RAG is particularly effective when the correct answer is not present in any retrieved document, achieving an impressive 11.8% accuracy in such cases. This is remarkable, given that traditional QA models often struggle to achieve this level of accuracy.

RAG achieves this success through its ability to generate correct answers even when the correct answer is not available in any retrieved document. This is made possible by its ability to extract relevant information from the retrieved documents and use it to inform its answer generation process.
